property.name: formNameOverride
property.label: Form Developer Name (override)
property.description: Optional. Pins this page to always show one form (e.g. AEBEQ_Eglise_Update), bypassing the ?form= URL query param — use this to give a form its own dedicated page. Leave blank to keep the current behavior (reads ?form=<DeveloperName> from the URL, defaults to AEBEQ_Account_Update).
